title: Sergeant Larson's onion speech on secrecy

tellings.quote: during our during our black introduction. He went into the onion thing.

plain: When he was first briefed into a secret programme at an overseas base in the early 1990s, a Sergeant Larson gave him "the onion thing," a speech comparing secrecy to the layers of an onion. So says Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who claims the NSA trained him to communicate with aliens and who wrote about it in his book Above Black. He tells Michels the speech came "during our black introduction," his first briefing into the hidden programme, as a lesson that each layer of secrecy hides another.
